column3: 在基准平面上开始草图（XY / XZ / YZ）

column3: 添加基本实体：长方体、圆柱、球体、圆锥或圆环

column3: 选中单个圆或圆弧以编辑其尺寸。

column3: 经典：传统的停靠面板加菜单栏。现代：顶部应用栏、工具竖栏加侧面板。im-touch：几乎无边框的全屏视图区，只保留浮动控件。切换立即生效；每种布局各自记住自己的排布。
设置会在下次启动时保留。

column3: 面上 %.0f 个牙峰；每头旋绕 %.1f 圈

column2: Add one by right-clicking a sketch element in sketch-edit mode and picking "Add Constraint".
column3: 在草图编辑模式下右键点击草图元素，选择“添加约束”即可添加。

column2: Also switches numeric fields between the in-app number pad and the system keyboard.
column3: 同时切换数值输入使用应用内数字键盘还是系统键盘。

column2: An unfinished sketch from your last session was found.
column3: 发现上次会话中未完成的草图。

column2: An unsaved project (never written to a file).
column3: 一个未保存的工程（从未写入文件）。

column2: As you draw, coloured ghost guides show alignment (perpendicular, parallel, on-axis, on-midpoint, etc.) and the cursor snaps. Full adds hover-to-charge references (dwell on a point / midpoint / face vertex to align from it). Reduced is the classic guides only, no hover-charging. Off is grid + endpoint only. Constraints live on the sketch right-click "Add Constraint" menu.
column3: 绘图时会用彩色幽灵引导线提示对齐（垂直、平行、在轴上、在中点等），光标也会捕捉。完整：悬停蓄力参考（在某点、中点、面顶点上停留即可从它对齐）。简化：只有经典引导线，无悬停蓄力。关闭：仅网格与端点。约束在草图右键的“添加约束”菜单里。

column2: Axes are 1-D primitives - they'll feed Revolve and future Pattern-Around-Axis ops. For now you can move them; rotate isn't meaningful on a line.
column3: 轴是一维图元——后续会用于旋转成型和绕轴阵列。目前可以移动它们；旋转对一条直线没有意义。

column2: Batched transform - undo/redo restores the whole set at once.
column3: 批量变换——撤销/重做会一次性恢复整组。

column2: Bevel the picked edge(s). Set distance in the popup.
column3: 对所选边倒角。在弹窗中设定距离。
实体在 %s 方向跨度为 %s。

column2: Bottom stays at %s - drag this end to make a cone.
column3: 底部保持在 %s——拖动这一端即可做出圆锥。

column2: Box origin = corner; the rest use it as the axis base / centre.
column3: 长方体的原点在角上；其余以它为轴底/中心。

column2: Cancel the action and discard its preview
column3: 取消该操作并丢弃预览

column2: Choose which mouse button orbits and which pans. Zoom is always the scroll wheel.
column3: 选择哪个鼠标键环绕、哪个平移。缩放始终用滚轮。

column2: Chord & Radius scale the arc (sweep kept); Sweep changes the angle. Press Enter to apply.
column3: 弦长和半径会缩放圆弧（扫掠角不变）；扫掠改变角度。按回车应用。

column2: Click a body in the viewport - clicking a face counts. Ctrl+click to add more bodies, or use box-select.
column3: 在视口中点击一个实体——点到面也算。按住 Ctrl 点击可加选实体，或用框选。

column2: Click a point in the viewport - snaps to the grid.
column3: 在视口中点击一个点——会捕捉到网格。

column2: Click again to start a new measurement.
column3: 再点一次可开始新的测量。

column2: Click in the sketch to place (Backspace undoes the last).
column3: 在草图中点击放置（退格键撤销上一次）。

column2: Click in the sketch - snaps to the grid.
column3: 在草图中点击——会捕捉到网格。

column2: Click the first point in the viewport…
Click the sketch elements you want projected - click each to add or remove. Use Select all / Clear below.
column3: 点击想要投影的草图元素——点击即可加入或移除。可用下方的全选 / 清除。

column2: Click two points a KNOWN distance apart (e.g. two marks on the ruler in your photo), then enter that distance.
column3: 点击相距已知距离的两个点（例如照片里尺子上的两个刻度），然后输入该距离。

column2: Click within ~8 px of an edge to pick it. Ctrl+click to add more edges to the sum.
column3: 在距边约 8 像素内点击即可选中。按住 Ctrl 点击可把更多边加入合计。

column2: Clicking the circular edge / face in the viewport also re-edits.
column3: 在视口中点击圆形边/面同样可重新编辑。
保形展开——整块，几乎不拉伸。

column2: Copy the selected sketch elements in a row or a grid: left, right, up and/or down.
column3: 将所选草图元素按一行或网格复制：左、右、上和/或下。

column2: Copy the selected sketch elements around an origin you specify.
column3: 将所选草图元素绕你指定的原点复制。

column2: Create a construction axis derived from the current selection.
column3: 基于当前所选创建基准轴。

column2: Create a construction plane derived from the current selection.
column3: 基于当前所选创建基准面。

column2: Create a stock OCCT primitive (box / cylinder / sphere / cone / torus). Picking one opens its parameter popup - defaults land a 10 mm / R5 mm shape at the world origin.
column3: 创建标准 OCCT 基本体（长方体/圆柱/球/圆锥/圆环）。选择后会打开参数弹窗——默认在世界原点生成 10 mm / R5 mm 的形状。

column2: Create: a sketch or a primitive solid
Creates a plane parallel to the base plane, offset along its normal.
column3: 创建与基准平面平行、沿其法向偏移的平面。

column2: Creates a plane parallel to the selected face, passing through the specified point.
column3: 创建与所选面平行、并过指定点的平面。

column2: Ctrl-click the other sketches (or their regions) in loft order - as many as you like - then click Loft again.
column3: 按住 Ctrl 按放样顺序点击其他草图（或其区域）——数量不限——再点一次放样。

column2: Cut the body in two with a plane. The ghost rectangle in the viewport is where the cut lands.
column3: 用一个平面把实体切成两半。视口里的幽灵矩形就是切割落点。

column2: Cut this region into the body the sketch was drawn on (preview in red).
column3: 把该区域切到草图所在的实体上（红色预览）。
删除所选草图元素（可撤销）

column2: Dimension tool (D): click a line, circle, point pair, or two lines, place the label, then type the value.
column3: 尺寸工具（D）：点击一条线、一个圆、一对点或两条线，放置标注，然后输入数值。

column2: Discard the current sketch entirely and leave sketch mode. Rewinds history to before the sketch was entered; the body returns to its pre-sketch state. Useful when you've started a sketch you don't want to keep - Esc-while-placing only cancels the in-progress shape, this clears everything.
column3: 彻底放弃当前草图并退出草图模式。会把历史回退到进入草图之前；实体回到画草图前的状态。适合画了一个不想保留的草图时使用——绘制过程中按 Esc 只取消正在画的形状，这里会清掉全部。

column2: Download the new build from the release page; the installer or portable zip will replace this one.
column3: 从发布页下载新版本；安装包或便携压缩包会替换这一份。

column2: Drag in the sketch to position, then Place Here.
column3: 在草图中拖动定位，然后点“放在此处”。

column2: Drag positive distance to extrude, negative to cut into the body the sketch sits on.
column3: 拖动为正值则拉伸，负值则切入草图所在实体。

column2: Drag the arrow to extrude this region into a body, or cut it into the parent.
column3: 拖动箭头把该区域拉伸成实体，或切入父体。

column2: Drag the arrow to push the sketch's regions into the body beneath them, or pull them out of it. Modifies that body in place - use Extrude From for a separate body.
column3: 拖动箭头把草图的区域推入其下方实体，或从中拉出。这会就地修改该实体——若想生成独立实体请用“从…拉伸”。

column2: Draw a circle: click centre, drag to radius.
column3: 画圆：点击圆心，拖到半径处。

column2: Draw an axis-aligned rectangle: click one corner, drag to the opposite.
column3: 画与坐标轴对齐的矩形：点一角，拖到对角。

column2: Draw straight line segments. Click to add vertices, Esc to finish.
column3: 画直线段。点击加点，Esc 结束。

column2: Duplicate the selected sketch elements at an offset.
column3: 把所选草图元素按偏移复制一份。

column2: Each profile is extruded through the others and the prisms are intersected (visual hull).
column3: 每个轮廓都穿透其他轮廓拉伸，再取棱柱的交集（视觉外壳）。

column2: Finish the current shape, keeping the points placed
column3: 结束当前形状，保留已放置的点

column2: Grows from its centre; attached arcs keep their angle. Press Enter to apply.
column3: 从中心生长；相连圆弧保持原有角度。按回车应用。
孔：%d 个保持、%d 个倾斜、%d 个竖直。

column2: Hollows the body, opening a face.
column3: 掏空实体，并打开一个面。

column2: Hover any toolbar button for a short description of what it does. Turn off if you already know the tools and find the pop-ups distracting.
column3: 悬停工具栏按钮会显示功能简述。若你已熟悉工具、觉得弹窗碍事可关闭。

column2: How many drawing guides to show, and how eagerly they snap. Max = Full plus wider catch ranges tuned for fingertips (touch). Full = the classic guides PLUS hover-to-charge references (dwell on a point to align from it). Reduced = the classic guides only, no hover-charging. Off = grid + endpoint only. Click to cycle.
column3: 显示多少绘图引导，以及多积极地捕捉。最大 = 完整再加更宽的捕捉范围（为指尖优化）。完整 = 经典引导再加悬停蓄力参考（在某点停留即可从它对齐）。简化 = 只有经典引导，无悬停蓄力。关闭 = 仅网格与端点。点击可循环切换。

column2: If on, Materializr asks GitHub for the latest release at startup and pops a small dialog when a newer build is available. Turn off for offline or portable use; you can still check manually via Help → Check for Updates.
column3: 开启后，Materializr 会在启动时向 GitHub 查询最新版本，若有更新会弹出小提示。离线或便携使用可关闭；仍可通过 帮助 → 检查更新 手动检查。

column2: If on, Materializr reopens every project you had open when you quit - one tab each - and skips the home screen. Closing a project's tab before quitting leaves it out; projects that have never been saved aren't restored here (crash recovery offers those separately).
column3: 开启后，Materializr 会在启动时重新打开你退出前打开的所有工程——每个一个标签——并跳过主界面。退出前关闭了标签的工程不会恢复；从未保存过的工程不在此恢复（崩溃恢复会另外提示）。

column2: Import an SVG file as sketch outlines: pick the file, set the width in the popup, click to place. Paths become closed regions - extrude a logo or engrave it onto a face.
column3: 把 SVG 文件作为草图轮廓导入：选文件、在弹窗里设定宽度、点击放置。路径会变成闭合区域——可拉伸成标志，或刻到某个面上。

column2: Insert text as real outline geometry: set string, font and letter height in the popup, then click to place. Letters become closed regions - extrude them or engrave them onto a face.
column3: 把文字作为真实的轮廓几何插入：在弹窗中设定字符串、字体和字高，然后点击放置。字形会变成闭合区域——可拉伸或刻到面上。

column2: It wasn't committed before the app closed (a crash, or a restart).
column3: 在应用关闭前没有提交（崩溃或重启导致）。

column2: Join the beta channel: update checks also consider pre-release builds (e.g. 1.3.0-beta.1) - early access to the next version's features, which may be rougher. Off keeps you on stable releases only.
column3: 加入测试通道：检查更新时也会考虑预发布版本（如 1.3.0-beta.1）——可提前体验下个版本的功能，可能更粗糙。关闭则只跟随稳定版。

column2: Keep the cutter bodies after cutting

Later cuts (holes, slots, chamfers) reorder beneath the thread automatically; the thread then re-cuts in the background. Sharp profiles on long threads can take a while each re-cut, so threading last is still fastest.
column3: 后续切割（孔、槽、倒角）会自动排到螺纹之下；螺纹随后在后台重新切割。长螺纹上的尖锐轮廓每次重切都比较慢，所以把螺纹放在最后仍然最快。

column2: Lathe: spin the selected sketch's profile around a Construction Axis into a new solid. Pick the axis next.
column3: 车削：把所选草图的轮廓绕基准轴旋转成新实体。接着选轴。

column2: Lay the body flat into a 2D pattern (cut + fold lines) for a laser cutter, CNC, or printed template. Mark it as foam board / sheet metal / wood to set how folds are processed.
column3: 把实体展开成 2D 图形（含切割与折线），供激光切割、CNC 或打印模板使用。可标注为泡沫板/钣金/木材，以决定折弯如何处理。

column2: Leave sketch mode and return to the 3D viewport. Keeps the sketch.
column3: 退出草图模式回到 3D 视口。草图会保留。

column2: Leave the sketch and throw away its changes?
License: GNU GPLv3, with additional permissions
Loaded from a saved project. Undo/redo work, but the parameters of a reloaded step can't be edited.
column3: 从已存工程载入。撤销/重做可用，但重新载入的步骤参数不可编辑。

column2: Lower = coarser, faster, with larger merged flat faces to sketch on. Higher = more faithful but heavier; very high may take a few seconds.
column3: 数值越低越粗糙、越快，合并出的平面更大更好画草图。越高越真实但更重；极高可能要几秒。

column2: Major must exceed minor - equal radii are a degenerate self-touching torus.
column3: 大半径必须大于小半径——半径相等会得到一个自相接触的退化圆环。

column2: Make a NEW body by extruding the sketch's closed regions, leaving any host body unchanged. Whole-sketch extrude assumes ONE outer boundary - for multi-shape sketches (SVG imports, text), click individual regions in the viewport (Ctrl+click for several) and extrude those instead.
column3: 通过拉伸草图的闭合区域生成新实体，原宿主实体不变。整张草图拉伸假定只有一个外边界——对于多形状草图（SVG 导入、文字），请在视口中逐个点击区域（按住 Ctrl 可多选）再拉伸。

column2: Make a NEW body from this region (Ctrl+click several regions to extrude them together). The source sketch/body is left unchanged.
column3: 由该区域生成新实体（按住 Ctrl 点选多个区域可一起拉伸）。源草图/实体保持不变。

column2: Materializr didn't close cleanly (a crash, hang, or restart).
column3: Materializr 上次没有正常关闭（崩溃、卡死或重启）。

column2: Materializr has three interface styles. Tap one to try it - the app behind this window switches instantly, so you can see the real thing. You can change your mind anytime in Settings > Appearance.
column3: Materializr 有三种界面风格。点一个试试——窗口背后的应用会立即切换，你能看到真实效果。随时可在 设置 > 外观 里更改。

column2: Materializr is designed for tablets and larger displays. On a small screen the panels and toolbars are cramped and some controls may be hard to reach - a tablet or larger is strongly recommended.
column3: Materializr 是为平板和更大屏幕设计的。在小屏幕上面板和工具栏会很拥挤，部分控件不易触及——强烈建议使用平板或更大设备。

column2: Materializr is free and open source, and always will be. If it has earned a place in your workflow, please consider supporting development - it keeps the project moving.
column3: Materializr 是自由开源软件，而且永远如此。如果它已在你的工作流中占了一席之地，欢迎支持开发——这能让项目继续前进。

column2: Mirror selected elements across a sketch line you'll pick next.
column3: 沿接下来选取的草图线镜像所选元素。

column2: Mirror the selected bodies across a plane you pick next.
column3: 沿接下来选取的平面镜像所选实体。

column2: Move / rotate with the gizmo like a construction plane. Sketch on it to trace the photo.
column3: 像基准面一样用手柄移动/旋转。在它上面画草图即可描照片。

column2: Move the angle slider to preview.
Move the hole this rim belongs to: drag one rim to tilt the bore, one straight side to reshape it, or select both rims to slide the whole hole.
column3: 移动这个边沿所属的孔：拖动一侧边沿可让孔倾斜，拖直边可重塑形状，或同时选两侧边沿整体平移孔。

column2: Multi-point spline. Click control points, Enter to finish.
column3: 多点样条。点击控制点，回车结束。

column2: Multi-start cuts per-groove - slower than a single start.
column3: 多头按槽分别切割——比单头慢。

column2: Need at least one cutter (ticked) and one body to keep.
column3: 至少需要一个勾选的刀具和一个要保留的实体。

column2: New tab: empty, open a file, or a recent project
column3: 新标签：空白、打开文件或打开最近的工程

column2: Non-Standard profiles cut per-turn - a long thread can take a while.

column2: Revolve the selected body/bodies around a Construction Axis (a fan, a hinge). Pick the axis next; multi-body selection rotates as a group.

column2: Scales orbit, pan, and zoom uniformly. Lower it if a trackpad feels too fast compared to desktop cursor speed; raise it for a snappier feel with a mouse. 1.00x is the default baseline.

column2: Select a profile (face or wire) and a path (wire) to sweep along.
column3: 选一个轮廓（面或线框）和一条要沿其扫掠的路径（线框）。

column2: Show or hide the classic interface's docked panels. Applies to the classic UI only - the im-touch shell arranges its own panels.
column3: 显示或隐藏经典界面的停靠面板。仅对经典界面生效——im-touch 外壳自己安排面板。

column2: Show the Move gizmo on the parent sketch. Drag an axis to reposition the sketch in 3D - geometry follows, so the sketch becomes a movable construction plane. Outside ortho view only.
column3: 在父草图上显示移动手柄。拖动某个轴即可在 3D 中重新定位草图——几何随之移动，草图于是变成可移动的基准面。仅在非正交视图下可用。

column2: Show the Move gizmo on the selected sketch. Drag an axis to reposition the sketch in 3D - its geometry rides along, so this effectively turns the sketch into a movable construction plane. Only available outside ortho view and sketch-edit mode.

column2: Show the Move gizmo on this axis. Drag an arrow to translate the axis origin; the direction is preserved.
column3: 在该轴上显示移动手柄。拖动箭头可平移轴原点；方向保持不变。

column2: Show the Move gizmo on this plane. Drag an axis arrow to nudge it; the live readout pinned to the cursor shows the offset along the plane's own normal.
column3: 在该平面上显示移动手柄。拖动某个轴箭头可微调；贴在光标上的实时读数会显示沿平面自身法向的偏移。

column2: Show the Rotate gizmo on the parent sketch. Drag a ring to spin the sketch around its centroid.

column2: Show the Rotate gizmo on the selected sketch. Drag a ring to spin the sketch around its centroid.

column2: Show the Rotate gizmo. Drag a ring to spin the plane around its origin; snap is 5° increments when snap-to-grid is on.

column2: Show the rotate gizmo. Drag rings to rotate around each axis. (E)

column2: Show the scale gizmo. Drag handles to resize. (R)

column3: LSCM，类似 Blender 的 UV 展开。得到一个连通块，把变形分摊开——切出来让柔性材料拉伸成形。关闭 = 精确可展片（适合刚性板材）。

column2: Max time between two clicks to count as a double-click. Raise it if double-clicking to select a body feels too fast on a trackpad. Default 0.30 s.
column3: 两次点击之间计为双击的最长时间。如果在触控板上双击选实体感觉太快，可调大。默认 0.30 秒。

column2: Off gives a clean shaded body. You can also toggle this later in Settings ▸ Rendering.
column3: 关闭会得到干净的着色实体。之后也可在 设置 → 渲染 中切换。

column3: 预填 STL 导入对话框。越低越粗越快，合并出的平面更大；越高越忠实但更重。

column2: Profiles are skinned in this order - top of the list is one end of the loft. Reorder with the arrows if the surface jumps back and forth. Flip a section if the loft pinches or twists there.

column3: 把草图沿其法向投影到该面，然后按深度刻入（凹雕）或凸出（浮雕）。

column2: Push/pull the sketch's regions into or out of the body beneath them.
column3: 把草图区域推入或拉出它们下方的实体。

column2: Rectangle origin: Corner = tap a corner, drag to the opposite; Center = tap the centre, drag to a corner. Tap to toggle.
column3: 矩形方式：角 = 点一角拖到对角；中心 = 点中心拖到角。点击可切换。

column3: 整体平移这个穿孔的孔——若想倾斜或重塑一端，请改选边沿。

column2: Sweep the body for faces that are exactly coplanar and merge them. Imported STEP parts arrive with flat surfaces split into pieces - the seam lines across an otherwise flat face, which also confuse Unfold and sketch-on-face. For a seam this leaves behind, select the two faces either side of it and merge those instead.
column3: 对实体进行扫掠，找出完全共面的面并合并。导入 STEP 零件后，平面常被拆成多块——就是平整面上的接缝线，它们也会干扰展开和面上草图。若仍留下接缝，请改选该接缝两侧的两个面再合并。

column2: Scale this face; the side walls re-slope to follow. Under 100% tapers it in, over 100% flares it out. Shorten the length to blend near the face instead of from the base.
column3: 缩放这个面；侧壁会随之重新倾斜。低于 100% 内收，高于 100% 外张。缩短长度可只在面附近过渡，而不是从底部跟随。

Type Width and Height, then Apply.

column3: 输入数值并按回车。形状从第一次点击处朝光标方向延伸。

column2: Type the straight-line distance between the arc's two ends and press Enter - or just click the end.
column3: 输入圆弧两端间的直线距离并按回车——或直接点击端点。

column2: Type the swept angle and Enter. 180 is a semicircle. Move the cursor across the chord to flip which way it bows.
column3: 输入扫掠角并按回车。180 是半圆。把光标拖过弦的另一侧可翻转弯曲方向。

column2:
Build a solid from silhouette sketches. Select two or more closed sketches on different planes (e.g. top + front + side outlines of the part) and click: each sketch is extruded through the others and the result is their intersection - the solid that matches every outline. Order doesn't matter.

Classic use: a base footprint plus curved front/side profiles gives a tapered body with rounded sides. Also the way to reconstruct an object from traced reference photos.
column3:
由侧影草图构建实体。在不同平面上选两个及以上闭合草图（比如零件的顶视 + 前视 + 侧视轮廓）再点击：每张草图都穿透其他草图拉伸，结果取它们的交集——即与所有轮廓都吻合的实体。顺序无关。

经典用法：一个底面轮廓配弯曲的前/侧轮廓，可得到侧壁圆润的收分体。也是按描摹照片还原物体的方法。

column2:
Loft a solid through two or more sketch profiles. Ctrl-click each sketch (or region) in order - first to last is the skinning order - then click Loft. With one selected, you'll be prompted to pick more.

GUIDED MODE: select ONE closed profile plus 1-2 OPEN curves and the profile is swept up along them - draw each curve as a side silhouette rising from the base (a slanted line = straight taper, an arc = rounded side). Strokes past the peak are ignored.

Best results when the profiles sit on PARALLEL planes with similar topology (all rectangles, all circles, etc.). Profiles on perpendicular planes or with very different vertex counts produce a tent / pyramid surface - that's the loft algorithm being honest, not a bug. For floor-to-vertical transitions, a Sweep along a guide curve is usually what you want instead.

Sections can be SKETCHES or FACES -- pick two faces to loft straight between them, which avoids the profile-building step entirely.
column3:
用两个及以上草图轮廓放样出实体。按住 Ctrl 按顺序点击每张草图（或区域）——先到后即蒙皮顺序——然后点放样。只选一个时会提示你继续选。

引导模式：选一个闭合轮廓加 1–2 条开放曲线，轮廓会沿它们扫掠上升——每条曲线画成从底部升起的侧影（斜线 = 直线收分，圆弧 = 圆润侧壁）。越过峰值的笔画会被忽略。

当各轮廓位于相互平行、拓扑相似的平面上时效果最好（都是矩形、都是圆等）。轮廓在垂直平面上或顶点数差异很大时，会生成帐篷/棱锥状曲面——这是放样算法如实反映的结果，不是 bug。底层到竖直过渡，通常该用沿引导曲线的扫掠。

截面可以是草图，也可以是面——直接选两个面放样即可避开画轮廓这一步。

column3: 圆角在被拒绝前允许耗时多久。OCCT 的过渡一旦开始无法取消，所以圆角会先在后台副本上运行，超过此值就放弃。大型或厚重实体上圆角确实更慢时可调大；若某个做不出的圆角一直让你等待，则调小。

column2:
Position one body against another and keep the relationship. Pick the body that stays put first, then the one that moves.

The mate type is inferred from what you picked - two round faces give Concentric, two flat faces give Planar, anything else Fasten - and you can change it afterwards. Editing the reference body carries everything mated to it along.
column3:
把一个实体贴靠到另一个并保持关系。先选保持不动的实体，再选要移动的。

配合类型由所选元素推断——两个圆面给同心，两个平面给平面，其他给固接——之后可更改。编辑参考体会带着与它配合的一切一起走。

column2: %s already has a mate (to %s) - a body can only be placed by one. Edit or delete that mate in the Mates section below first, or pick the bodies in the other order if you meant to mate %s to it instead.
column3: %s 已有配合（与 %s）——一个实体只能被一个配合定位。请先在下方“配合”里编辑或删除那个配合，或者如果你本意是把 %s 配合到它，就调换选择顺序。

column2: %s is now mated to %s (Fasten). It's holding its current position - nothing moved. Open the Mates section below to set an offset, or pick faces on both bodies first for a Planar / Concentric mate that aligns them.
column3: %s 现已配合到 %s（固接）。它保持在当前位置——没有任何移动。展开下方的“配合”设定偏移，或先分别选两个实体上的面来做平面/同心配合，让它们对齐。

column2: %s is now mated to %s (%s), aligned to the picked faces. Adjust offset, roll or Flip in the Mates section below.
column3: %s 现已配合到 %s（%s），已对齐到所选的面。可在下方“配合”里调整偏移、滚动或翻转。

column2: Only Fasten is available: these bodies have no sketch-derived faces to align to. Primitive and imported bodies cannot carry face references.
column3: 只有固接可用：这些实体没有可对齐的草图派生面。基本体和导入体不带面引用。

column2: Only available with anchored faces: a rotation or flip recaptured from this body's current (already-rotated) position, instead of a real face's orientation, would silently compound on the next solve.
column3: 仅在面已锚定时可用：从这个实体当前（已旋转过的）位置重新捕获旋转或翻转，会在下次求解时悄悄叠加，而不是按真实面的朝向。

column2:
Fill an opening with a single fitted surface. Ctrl-click the ring of edges around the void and click Patch: the surface is fitted across them and, if they bound a hole in one body, sewn back in so the body closes.

CONTINUITY is the point of the tool. Position just plugs the hole. Tangent leaves the rim along the surrounding faces, so there is no crease where the patch meets them. Curvature matches how those faces are bending as well, for a blend that reads as one surface.

Tangency needs something to be tangent TO: where the faces around the opening stand square to it - a flat lid on vertical walls - there is no tangent surface to find, and the panel says so rather than pretending. Slope those walls even a few degrees and it works.

Select faces as well as edges to say which side a bridging patch should blend into.
column3:
用一张拟合曲面填住开口。按住 Ctrl 点击空洞周围的整圈边再点补面：曲面会跨这些边拟合，如果它们围成某个实体上的孔，就会被缝回去使实体封闭。

连续性才是这个工具的关键。位置只是把洞堵上。相切让边沿沿周围面延伸，补面与它们相接处没有折痕。曲率还匹配那些面的弯曲程度，得到看起来像一张面的过渡。

相切需要有东西可相切：当开口周围的面与它成直角——竖直壁上扣一个平面盖——就不存在相切曲面可找，面板会如实说明而不是假装。把那些壁倾斜哪怕几度就可以。

除了边，也可以选择面，来说明过渡补片应当融合到哪一侧。

column2:
Stitch surfaces into one body - and into a solid when they close.

Select the surfaces (Patch results, imported shells) and click. Faces that meet are joined; if the result encloses a volume you get a solid you can fillet, shell and boolean like any other. If it doesn't, you get the joined shell and a count of the edges still open, which is how many gaps are left to patch.

Joined at the tightest tolerance that closes, so surfaces that only nearly meet are not silently welded together.

把曲面缝成一个实体——当它们闭合时成为一个实体。

选择曲面（补面结果、导入的壳）并点击。相接的面会被连接；若结果围出体积，就得到能像其他实体一样倒圆、抽壳、布尔的实体。若不能，你会得到缝合后的壳以及仍开放的边数——也就是还剩多少缺口要补。

以能闭合的最紧公差接合，所以只是几乎相接的曲面不会被悄悄焊在一起。

Could not use this image - it must be a PNG / JPEG / BMP no larger than 16384 x 16384.
column3: 无法使用此图像——必须是 PNG / JPEG / BMP，且不超过 16384 x 16384。

column2: Reference image imported - set its real size with Calibrate, then sketch over it.
column3: 参考图已导入——用校准设定真实尺寸，然后在上面画草图。

column3: 无法解码图像以进行校准。
图像已按真实尺寸校准。

column2: Imported STL - %d faces. Pick a flat face → Sketch on Face to trace it.
column3: 已导入 STL——%d 个面。选一个平面面 → 在面上草图 来描摹它。

column3: 选一个实体，或选某个面板的若干面，来展开。

The flattened net overlaps itself - it may need to be cut into pieces.
column3: 展开图有自重叠——可能需要拆成几块。

column3: 无法读取“%s”——访问权限可能已被撤销。

column3: 已在新标签打开——未保存。

column2: %d parts opened in a new tab - unsaved.
column3: %d 个零件已在新标签打开——未保存。

column2: %d sketches opened in a new tab - unsaved.
column3: %d 张草图已在新标签打开——未保存。

column3: %d 个零件已发送到 %s——拖动放置。

column2: No file-dialog program found - install 'zenity' (GNOME) or 'kdialog' (KDE) to Open / Save / Export.
column3: 找不到文件对话框程序——请安装 'zenity'（GNOME）或 'kdialog'（KDE）以使用 打开/保存/导出。

column2: That project is already open - switched to its tab.
column3: 该工程已打开——已切换到它的标签。

column2: Finish or cancel the sketch before switching tabs.
column3: 切换标签前请先完成或取消草图。

column2: Wait for the thread re-cut to finish before switching tabs.
column3: 切换标签前请等待螺纹重切完成。

column2: Couldn't reopen the last project - access may have been revoked.
column3: 无法重新打开上次的工程——访问权限可能已被撤销。

column2: Opened a local backup - the original is gone. Save to keep it.
column3: 已打开本地备份——原文件已不存在。请保存以保留它。

column2: 1 project from your last session is missing.
column3: 上次会话中有 1 个工程缺失。

column2: Some projects from your last session are missing.
column3: 上次会话中部分工程缺失。

column2: Couldn't write the original file - choose where to save
column3: 无法写入原文件——请选择保存位置

column2: This project was saved in an older format: %d body(ies) are frozen and can't be edited by value. The shapes are intact - to change a baked round/chamfer, select its face and use Remove Feature to restore the sharp edge, then redo it. New saves won't have this.
column3: 该工程以较旧格式保存：%d 个实体被冻结，无法按数值编辑。形状完好——要修改已烘焙的圆角/倒角，请选中其面并用移除特征还原尖边，再重新做一次。新保存的文件不会有此问题。

column2: This project was saved in an older format: %d feature(s) are frozen and can't be edited by value. The shapes are intact - to change a baked round/chamfer, select its face and use Remove Feature to restore the sharp edge, then redo it. New saves won't have this.
column3: 该工程以较旧格式保存：%d 个特征被冻结，无法按数值编辑。形状完好——要修改已烘焙的圆角/倒角，请选中其面并用移除特征还原尖边，再重新做一次。新保存的文件不会有此问题。

column2: Couldn't open "%s" - access may have been revoked.
column3: 无法打开“%s”——访问权限可能已被撤销。

column2: Opened a local backup of "%s" - the original is gone. Save to keep it.
column3: 已打开“%s”的本地备份——原文件已不存在。请保存以保留它。

column2: Couldn't open "%s" - the file may have moved or been deleted.
column3: 无法打开“%s”——文件可能已移动或被删除。

column2: Import failed partway through - kept the bodies added before the error.
column3: 导入中途失败——已保留出错前加入的实体。

column2: Nothing to export - those bodies have no geometry.
column3: 没有可导出的内容——那些实体没有几何。

column2: Combine needs sketches that share a plane.
Duplicated "%s" - edit the copy freely (e.g. resize holes); the original is untouched.
column3: 已复制“%s”——可随意编辑副本（如调整孔的大小）；原件不受影响。

column2: Can't sketch on a curved face - use Add Plane… to place a construction plane.
column3: 无法在曲面画草图——请用 添加平面… 放置基准面。

column2: Couldn't reopen the unfinished sketch's tab; it's still saved.
column3: 无法重新打开未完成草图的标签；它仍已保存。

column2: Recovered unsaved work into a new tab.
column3: 已把未保存的工作恢复到新标签。
%d 个已恢复的工程无法重新打开。

column2: A step was skipped after an error - save a copy.
column3: 出错后有步骤被跳过——请另存一份。

column2: not enough lines to be a coordinate file
column3: 行数不足以构成坐标文件

column2: fewer coordinates than the count line promises
column3: 坐标数少于计数行所声明的

column2: could not find the leading edge (is this a Selig file?)
column3: 找不到前缘（这是 Selig 格式吗？）

column2: not enough points on one of the surfaces
column3: 其中一个面上的点不足

column2: coordinates are not chord-normalised (expected x from 0 to 1)
column3: 坐标未按弦长归一化（x 应在 0 到 1 之间）

column2: Those faces point in opposite directions - they lie in the same plane, but the material is on opposite sides, so they are different surfaces of the part rather than two halves of one. Merging can't join them, and wouldn't add material to either.
column3: 这些面朝向相反——它们同处一个平面，但材料在相反两侧，所以是零件的不同表面，而不是同一面的两半。合并不能连接它们，也不会给任一侧加料。

column2: Those faces don't touch - merging dissolves the edge between two faces, and there isn't one. If a small step separates them, level it first, then merge.
column3: 这些面并不相接——合并会消去两个面之间的边，而它们之间没有边。若它们之间有个小台阶，请先削平再合并。

column2: That merge would have moved material, so it was refused - the faces are one surface, but joining them would reshape the part rather than tidy it.
column3: 该合并会移动材料，因此被拒绝——面确实属于同一曲面，但连接它们会重塑零件而不是整理它。

column2: Couldn't find those faces on the body any more - they may already have been merged.
column3: 无法在实体上再找到那些面——它们可能已被合并。

column2: Pick two or more faces on the SAME body to merge them.
column3: 请在同一实体上选两个或更多面来合并。

column2: Couldn't merge those - they aren't close enough to one surface, or the merge wouldn't hold together.
column3: 无法合并——它们不够接近同一曲面，或合并后无法保持整体。

column2: Nothing exactly coplanar left to merge - pick the faces either side of a seam and try again.
column3: 已没有完全共面的面可合并——请选接缝两侧的面再试。

column2: %d open sketch(es) ignored - rails need exactly ONE closed base profile.
column3: 已忽略 %d 张开放草图——轨道模式需要恰好一个闭合基础轮廓。

column2: Guided loft takes at most two rail curves - deselect the extras.
column3: 引导放样最多两条轨道曲线——请取消多余选择。

column2: Selected %d closed profile(s) + %d open curve(s). Loft needs 2+ closed profiles (sections), or exactly 1 closed + 1-2 open (rails).
column3: 已选 %d 个闭合轮廓 + %d 条开放曲线。放样需要 2 个以上闭合轮廓（截面），或恰好 1 个闭合 + 1–2 条开放（轨道）。

column2: Guided loft failed - rails must rise away from the base profile's plane.
column3: 引导放样失败——轨道必须从基础轮廓平面升起。

column2: Sketch re-linked - editing it will drive the body again.
column3: 草图已重新关联——编辑它将再次驱动该实体。

column2: Updated the sketch, but the body built from it couldn't rebuild from the new shape - the model is unchanged.
column3: 草图已更新，但由它构建的实体无法按新形状重建——模型未改动。

column2: Couldn't update the model for that sketch change - a downstream feature (step %d: %s) couldn't follow it, so the model was left unchanged.
column3: 无法为该草图改动更新模型——下游特征（第 %d 步：%s）跟不上，因此模型保持原样。

column2: Couldn't update the model for that sketch change - a downstream feature couldn't follow it, so the model was left unchanged.
column3: 无法为该草图改动更新模型——下游特征跟不上，因此模型保持原样。

column2: Model updated - but %s couldn't follow the change and was DISABLED. Its edge/face picks no longer exist on the new shape - delete it and re-apply the feature (re-enabling would retry the old picks).
column3: 模型已更新——但 %s 跟不上改动并已被禁用。它的边/面选择在新形状上已不存在——请删除并重新施加该特征（重新启用只会重试旧的选择）。

column2: Boundary Fill needs at least two sketches with a closed region (e.g. top + front + side silhouettes).
column3: 边界填充至少需要两张带闭合区域的草图（例如 顶视 + 前视 + 侧视 轮廓）。

column2: Boundary Fill: the silhouettes don't enclose a common volume - make sure they overlap in space.
column3: 边界填充：这些轮廓没有围出公共体积——请确认它们在空间中相互重叠。

column2: Patch needs the edges around the opening - Ctrl-click each one, then click Patch.
column3: 补面需要开口周围的边——按住 Ctrl 逐条选中，再点补面。

column2: Patch: no surface fits these edges. They need to form one closed ring around the opening.
column3: 补面：没有曲面能拟合这些边。它们需要围绕开口形成一个闭合环。

column2: Sew needs the surfaces selected - pick the bodies to stitch together, then click Sew.
column3: 缝合需要先选曲面——选出要缝在一起的体，再点缝合。

column2: Sew: those surfaces wouldn't join - they may not touch anywhere, or there was nothing to stitch.
column3: 缝合：这些曲面无法接合——它们可能处处不相碰，或者没有可缝的东西。
已把 %d 个面缝成实体。

column2: Sewed %d faces, but %d edge(s) are still open - it isn't a solid yet.
column3: 已缝合 %d 个面，但仍有 %d 条边开放——还不是实体。

column2: Thread couldn't re-cut on the new geometry - check the Thread step.
column3: 螺纹无法在新几何上重切——请检查螺纹步骤。

column2: Thread re-cut cancelled - the Thread step is suspended; re-enable it in History to re-cut.
column3: 螺纹重切已取消——螺纹步骤被挂起；可在历史里重新启用再切。

column2: %s needs solid geometry, and this is an imported mesh - a reference body. Sketch on it and snap to it all you like, then model the part alongside it.
column3: %s 需要实体几何，而这是导入的网格——参考体。你可以在它上面随意画草图并捕捉，然后在旁边建模这个零件。

column2: %s needs solid geometry, and one of the selected bodies is an imported mesh - a reference body. Leave the import out of the selection.
column3: %s 需要实体几何，而所选实体中有一个是导入网格——参考体。请把导入体排除在选择之外。

column2: Can't extrude a curved face - extrude works on flat faces only.
column3: 无法拉伸曲面——拉伸只对平面面有效。

column2: Subtract: this profile doesn't reach any body - nothing to cut. Extrude it further, or drag the other way.
column3: 减除：该轮廓没碰到任何实体——没有可切割的。请拉得更远，或反向拖动。

column2: Cut %d of %d bodies - the rest couldn't make a valid solid and were left alone.
column3: 已切 %d 个实体（共 %d 个）——其余无法形成有效实体，已保持原样。

column2: Push/Pull works on flat faces - not curved or fillet faces.
column3: 推/拉只对平面面有效——曲面或圆角面不行。

column2: This fillet can't be rebuilt on the current body - its edges reference geometry that a later feature changed. Left as-is; delete it and re-apply the feature on the updated body.
column3: 该圆角无法在当前实体上重建——它的边引用了后续特征改动过的几何。已保持原样；请删除并在更新后的实体上重新施加该特征。

column2: This chamfer can't be rebuilt on the current body - its edges reference geometry that a later feature changed. Left as-is; delete it and re-apply the feature on the updated body.
column3: 该倒角无法在当前实体上重建——它的边引用了后续特征改动过的几何。已保持原样；请删除并在更新后的实体上重新施加该特征。

column2: This fillet/chamfer is baked into the model - the geometry you clicked has no editable operation behind it. Re-apply it to make it adjustable.
column3: 该圆角/倒角已烘焙进模型——你点击的几何背后没有可编辑操作。重新施加一次即可让它可调。

column2: Fillet couldn't be built on those edges - the result wasn't valid geometry. Try a smaller size or fewer edges.
column3: 无法在这些边上构建圆角——结果不是有效几何。请试试更小的尺寸或更少的边。

column2: Chamfer couldn't be built on those edges - the result wasn't valid geometry. Try a smaller size or fewer edges.
column3: 无法在这些边上构建倒角——结果不是有效几何。请试试更小的尺寸或更少的边。

column2: Only simple through-holes can be moved for now - not pockets, countersunk, or stepped holes.
column3: 目前只能移动简单的通孔——沉孔、台阶孔等不行。

column2: Move Face needs a flat face - pick a planar face.
column3: 移动面需要一个平面面——请选一个平面。

column2: Hollow body: the preview stays put - the change applies when you release (re-shelled automatically).
column3: 掏空实体：预览保持不动——松手后才应用改动（会自动重新抽壳）。

column2: Union couldn't make a valid solid from these bodies - they may not overlap, share a coincident face, or the geometry is too degenerate.
column3: 合并无法从这些实体生成有效实体——它们可能不重叠、不共享重合面，或几何过于退化。

column2: Intersect couldn't make a valid solid from these bodies - they may not overlap, share a coincident face, or the geometry is too degenerate.
column3: 相交无法从这些实体生成有效实体——它们可能不重叠、不共享重合面，或几何过于退化。

column2: Subtract couldn't make a valid solid from these bodies - they may not overlap, share a coincident face, or the geometry is too degenerate.
column3: 减除无法从这些实体生成有效实体——它们可能不重叠、不共享重合面，或几何过于退化。

column2: Same entity - pick a different one.
These lines can't be dimensioned to each other (they meet, or are collinear).
column3: 这两条线之间无法标注尺寸（它们相交或共线）。

column2: A single point has no dimension - pick a second entity.
column3: 单个点没有尺寸——请选第二个元素。

column2: Fix up geometry: fill an opening, stitch surfaces into a solid, merge split faces, or take a feature back off
column3: 修复几何：填补开口、把曲面缝成实体、合并被拆开的面，或撤掉某个特征

column2: Some faces are doubly-curved - score/fold lines approximate the curvature.
column3: 部分面是双曲的——折/压线只是近似曲率。

column2: Not a closed solid - no volume or mass.
column3: 不是封闭实体——没有体积或质量。

column2: Pick a material to see the mass.
column3: 选一种材质即可看到质量。

column2: Estimated the way a slicer counts it: the walls and the top and bottom skins are solid (each wall is a %s line), the inside is filled at the infill percentage. Supports, brim and purge are not included.
column3: 按切片器的算法估算：壁面与上下表皮为实心（每层壁为一条 %s 线），内部按填充率填充。不含支撑、裙边和废料。

column2: Metal and varnished wood reflect a photographed studio. Off: a plain drawn studio instead.
column3: 金属和上漆木材会反射实拍影棚。关闭：改用绘制的简易影棚。

column2: Fill closed regions for SVG and DXF export (laser engraving): tap a region to fill it, tap again to clear. Cosmetic only - it never affects Extrude, Push/Pull or anything else you model.
column3: 为 SVG 和 DXF 导出（激光雕刻）填充闭合区域：点击区域填充，再点取消。仅外观用途——绝不影响拉伸、推/拉或任何建模。

column2: Fill closed regions for SVG and DXF export (laser engraving): click a region to fill it, click again to clear. Cosmetic only - it never affects Extrude, Push/Pull or anything else you model.
column3: 为 SVG 和 DXF 导出（激光雕刻）填充闭合区域：点击区域填充，再点取消。仅外观用途——绝不影响拉伸、推/拉或任何建模。

column2: Fill needs a closed region - click inside a closed shape.
column3: 填充需要闭合区域——请在闭合形状内部点击。

column2: Modify tools: trim, offset, fill, copy, mirror, linear and circular patterns
column3: 修改工具：修剪、偏移、填充、复制、镜像、线性与环形阵列

column2: Circle origin: Center = click the centre, drag the radius; 2-Point = the two clicks are opposite ends of the diameter (rim passes through the first click). Click to toggle.
column3: 圆心方式：中心 = 点圆心拖半径；两点 = 两次点击为直径两端（边沿经过第一次点击处）。点击切换。

column2: Rectangle origin: Corner = click a corner, drag to the opposite; Center = click the centre, drag to a corner. Click to toggle.
column3: 矩形方式：角 = 点一角拖到对角；中心 = 点中心拖到角。点击切换。

column2: Cut a helical screw thread into the picked cylindrical face - external on a boss, internal in a hole. Pitch / depth / handedness in the popup.
column3: 在所选圆柱面上切出螺旋螺纹——凸台上外螺纹，孔内内螺纹。螺距/深度/旋向在弹窗里。

column2: Delete the picked face and heal the body over it - takes a baked fillet or chamfer back to a sharp edge so it can be re-applied.
column3: 删除所选面并把实体在此缝合——把烘焙的圆角或倒角还原成尖边，以便重新施加。

column2: Delete the picked face(s) and heal the surrounding faces back together - take a baked fillet/chamfer back to a sharp edge so it can be re-applied, or clean a round/hole off an imported part.
column3: 删除所选面并把周围面缝合回去——把烘焙的圆角/倒角还原成尖边以便重新施加，或清除导入零件上的圆角/孔。

column2: Draft angle for moulding or printing: tilt the picked face(s) by an angle about a fixed neutral plane. Unlike Rotate it takes SEVERAL faces at one angle (all four walls of a box) and works on cylindrical and conical faces too - a cylinder drafts into a cone.
column3: 用于注塑或打印的拔模角：让所选面绕固定的中性面倾斜。与旋转不同，它能让多个面同一角度（箱体四面壁），圆柱面和圆锥面也适用——圆柱会拔成圆锥。

column2: Drag the face along its normal to extrude (+) or cut (−) into the body.
column3: 沿法向拖动该面即可拉出新料（+）或切入实体（−）。

column2: Finish the sketch and leave sketch mode
column3: 完成草图并退出草图模式

column2: Flatten the SELECTED faces into a 2D pattern (cut + fold lines) for a laser/CNC/printed template. Pick the faces of one panel (e.g. a skin) - unfolding a whole closed body rarely makes sense.
column3: 把所选面展平成 2D 图样（含切割与折线），供激光/CNC/打印模板。选某个面板（如蒙皮）的面——把整个封闭实体展开通常没有意义。

column2: Focus: hide the side panel (tap again for viewport only)
column3: 聚焦：隐藏侧面板（再点则只剩视口）

column2: Focus: hide the tool rail too (viewport only)
column3: 聚焦：连工具栏也隐藏（只剩视口）

column2: Show the model tree (bodies, sketches, construction)
column3: 显示模型树（实体、草图、构造）

column2: Hollow the body, removing the picked face. Wall thickness in the popup.
column3: 掏空实体，移除所选面。壁厚在弹窗里。

column2: Import an aerofoil section (Selig or Lednicer coordinates from airfoiltools.com): pick the file, set the chord in the popup, tap to place the leading edge.
column3: 导入翼型截面（Selig 或 Lednicer 坐标，来自 airfoiltools.com）：选文件、弹窗设弦长、点击放置前缘。

column2: Leave sketch mode, keeping the sketch
column3: 退出草图模式，保留草图

column2: Make a NEW body by extruding this face's silhouette (source body unchanged).
column3: 拉伸该面的侧影生成新实体（源实体不变）。

column2: Merge faces that are really one surface into one face. Imported STEP parts arrive with flat surfaces split into pieces - the seam lines across an otherwise flat face, which also confuse Unfold and sketch-on-face.
column3: 把确实属于同一曲面的面合并成一个。导入 STEP 零件后平整面常被拆成多块——即平整面上的接缝线，它们也会干扰展开和面上草图。

column2: Offset a chain: tap an edge to take the whole connected run, then drag or type the distance. The side you are on picks the direction.
column3: 偏移一条链：点击一条边即可取整段相连的链，然后拖动或输入距离。你所在的一侧决定方向。

column2: Project a sketch onto this face along the sketch's normal, then engrave (cut in) or emboss (raise out) to a depth - wrap a logo or text onto a cylinder. Sketch, mode and depth in the popup; click sketch regions in the viewport to project only those.
column3: 沿草图法向把草图投影到该面，然后按深度刻入（凹雕）或凸出（浮雕）——可把标志或文字包到圆柱上。草图、模式与深度在弹窗里；在视口中点击草图区域则只投影那些区域。

column2: Resize a cylindrical hole / pin to an exact diameter.
column3: 把圆柱孔/销调整到精确直径。

column2: Re-slope the side walls toward a scaled copy of this face - under 100% tapers it in, over 100% flares it out. Blend length in the popup.
column3: 让侧壁朝该面的缩放副本重新倾斜——低于 100% 内收，高于 100% 外张。过渡长度在弹窗里。

column2: Snap off - tap for step / toggle
column3: 捕捉已关——点击设定步长/切换

column2: Snap ON - tap for step / toggle
column3: 捕捉已开——点击设定步长/切换

column2: Start a new sketch lying on the picked face.
column3: 在所选面上开始新草图。

column2: Throw the sketch away and leave (asks to confirm)
column3: 丢弃草图并退出（会要求确认）

column2: Writes filled regions in grey so they stay distinct from the black outlines. Laser software can give each colour or layer its own operation, e.g. cut the outlines and engrave the grey. In SVG a fill is a solid shape; DXF has no solid fill, so it is written as closed outlines on a separate FILL layer. Off: fills keep the outline colour.
column3: 把填充区域写成灰色，以与黑色轮廓区分。激光软件可为每种颜色或图层设定不同工序，例如切轮廓、刻灰色。SVG 中填充是实心形状；DXF 无实心填充，因此写成单独 FILL 图层上的闭合轮廓。关闭：填充沿用轮廓颜色。

column2: Frame the selection (or everything, if none)
column3: 框住所选（若未选则全部）

column2: Click a shortcut, then press the new key combination. Esc cancels. A combination already in use is taken from its old action. Esc, Enter and Space cannot be assigned.
column3: 点击一个快捷键，然后按下新的组合键。Esc 取消。已被占用的组合会从原操作上取走。Esc、Enter 和空格不能分配。

column2: Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in Settings → Navigation.
column3: 快捷键可在 设置 → 导航 中修改。

column2: Commit the running tool (and typed value)
column3: 提交当前工具（及输入的数值）

column2: Cancel the running tool or gizmo drag
column3: 取消当前工具或手柄拖动

column2: Remove the last spline point or stamp
column3: 删除最后一个样条点或印章

column2: Cancel the shape; again for Select; again to leave the sketch
column3: 取消形状；再按切到选择；再按退出草图

column2: Select a sketch or a face to extrude first.
column3: 请先选一张草图或一个面来拉伸。

column2: Select a sketch (or a region of one) to cut with first.
column3: 请先选草图（或其中区域）以进行切割。

column2: This sketch has no closed contour to extrude - close its open ends first.
column3: 该草图没有闭合轮廓可拉伸——请先闭合开放端。

column2: That region has no closed contour to cut with.
column3: 该区域没有闭合轮廓可用于切割。

column2: Select the body (or bodies) to rotate first.
Select the sketch to revolve first.
column3: 请先选要旋转成型的草图。

column2: This sketch has no closed contour to revolve - close its open ends first.
column3: 该草图没有闭合轮廓可旋转——请先闭合开放端。

column2: Select the target body together with the sketch to use Union, Subtract or Intersect.
column3: 使用合并/减除/相交时，请把目标实体与草图一起选中。

column2: Nothing could be rotated - bodies placed by a mate are skipped.
column3: 没有可旋转的对象——由配合定位的实体会跳过。

column2: The Lathe couldn't be built from this profile. Check that it doesn't cross the axis.
column3: 无法用该轮廓构建车削体。请检查它是否穿过轴线。

column2: That sketch has no closed contour to push or pull - close its open ends first.
column3: 该草图没有闭合轮廓可推/拉——请先闭合开放端。

column2: Select a sketch region or a flat face to push/pull first.
column3: 请先选一个草图区域或平面面来推/拉。

column2: Restored the features an earlier sketch change had switched off.
column3: 已恢复此前草图改动关掉的特征。

column2: Copy geometry that lies on this plane into the sketch: tap a body edge, a cross-section line or another sketch's line or circle. Hold Ctrl to take the whole connected run.
column3: 把位于该平面上的几何复制进草图：点击实体边、截面线，或其他草图的线或圆。按住 Ctrl 可一次取整段相连的链。

column2: Copy geometry that lies on this plane into the sketch: click a body edge, a cross-section line, or another sketch's line or circle. Ctrl+click takes the whole connected run of lines.
column3: 把位于该平面上的几何复制进草图：点击实体边、截面线，或其他草图的线或圆。按住 Ctrl 可一次取整段相连的链。

column2: To offset just some segments, select them first, then choose Offset.
column3: 若只想偏移部分线段，请先选中它们再选偏移。

column2: Offsetting only what you had selected. Hover one of those and click to choose it.
column3: 只偏移你已选中的对象。悬停其中之一并点击选中。
平移（始终如此，不论键位设置）

column2: Select a face or sketch region

On (default): the step you pick below is a starting point. When the grid cells would be too small to click, the sketch uses a coarser step (0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10 ...), and a finer one when you zoom well in. The number on the badge shows the step in use. Off: the grid and snapping always use exactly the step you picked, at every zoom.
column3: 开启（默认）：下方所选步长只是起点。当网格单元小到难以点击时，草图会使用更粗的步长（0.1、0.5、1、5、10…），放大时则用更细的。角标上的数字显示当前使用的步长。关闭：网格与捕捉在任何缩放下都严格使用你选的步长。

column2: How wide a grid cell may get before the step changes while you zoom. Higher = coarser grid, steps change sooner when zooming out. Lower = finer grid. Default 8.
column3: 缩放时，网格单元宽到多少就切换步长。越大 = 网格更粗，缩小视图时更早切换；越小 = 网格更细。默认 8。

column2: Grid step scaling lives in the snap popup (click the grid badge in the viewport).
column3: 网格步长缩放设在捕捉弹窗里（点击视口中的网格角标）。

column2: Makes the whole interface larger or smaller: text, buttons, spacing and panels together. 100% is the size picked for your display. Takes effect on restart.
column3: 让整个界面变大或变小：文字、按钮、间距和面板一起。100% 是为你的显示器选定的尺寸。重启后生效。

column2: Touch mode sets its own size, so this is off while Touch mode is on.
column3: 触控模式有自己的尺寸，所以开启触控模式时此项不可用。

column2: This launch was started with --ui-scale, which takes priority.
column3: 本次启动使用了 --ui-scale，它优先。

column2: Restart Materializr to apply the new size, then use Reset panel layout if the panels look cramped.
column3: 重启 Materializr 以应用新尺寸，若面板显得拥挤可再用 重置面板布局。

column2: Draw a circle: press the centre, drag to the radius. Tap again while it is active to choose Center or 2-Point.
column3: 画圆：按住圆心，拖到半径。激活时再点一下可切换 中心 或 两点。

column2: Draw a rectangle: press one corner, drag to the opposite. Tap again while it is active to choose Corner or Center.
column3: 画矩形：按住一角，拖到对角。激活时再点一下可切换 角 或 中心。

column2: Draw a circle: click centre, drag to radius. Click again while it is active to choose Center or 2-Point (the two clicks are opposite ends of the diameter).
column3: 画圆：点圆心，拖到半径。激活时再点一下可切换 中心 或 两点（两次点击为直径两端）。

column2: Draw an axis-aligned rectangle: click one corner, drag to the opposite. Click again while it is active to choose Corner or Center (click the centre, drag to a corner).
column3: 画与坐标轴对齐的矩形：点一角，拖到对角。激活时再点一下可切换 角 或 中心（点中心拖到角）。

column2: Construction geometry: reference lines that help you draw but are not part of the shape - they never affect extrudes or exports. With elements selected, tap to turn them into construction (or back). Otherwise tap to draw the next shapes as construction.
column3: 构造几何：辅助你绘图的参考线，不属于形状——永远不会影响拉伸或导出。有元素被选中时，点击可把它们转为构造（或转回）。否则点击表示把接下来画的形状作为构造。

column2: Construction geometry: reference lines that help you draw but are not part of the shape - they never affect extrudes or exports. With elements selected, click to turn them into construction (or back). Otherwise click to draw the next shapes as construction.
column3: 构造几何：辅助你绘图的参考线，不属于形状——永远不会影响拉伸或导出。有元素被选中时，点击可把它们转为构造（或转回）。否则点击表示把接下来画的形状作为构造。

column2: Orbit, or drive the running tool
Sealed hollow. Click faces to open them.
column3: 已封闭的空腔。点击面可将其打开。

column2: Hollow the body into a sealed shell. Click faces afterwards to leave them open.
column3: 把实体掏成封闭薄壳。之后点击面可让它们保持开口。
另外每隔几分钟自动保存

column2: Big model: the body updates when you finish the sketch.
column3: 模型较大：完成草图后实体才会更新。

column2: Circumscribed: the circle through the corners.
Click a corner where two lines meet. Set the size first; it stays for the next corner.
column3: 点击两条线相交的角点。先设定尺寸，该尺寸会沿用到下一个角点。

column2: Click a line in the sketch...
Click the centre (or the first end of the diameter).
column3: 点击圆心（或直径的第一个端点）。

column2: Click the centre. Choose how the size is measured below.
column3: 点击圆心，然后在下方选择尺寸的标注方式。

column2: Click the first corner (or the centre).
column3: 点击第一个角点（或圆心）。

column2: Click the start of the arc.
Click the start of the line.
Deleting a sketch also deletes the bodies built from it
column3: 删除草图会同时删除由它生成的实体

column2: Drag to size it, or type an exact size and angle below, then click or press Place.
column3: 拖动可调整大小，也可在下方输入精确尺寸和角度，然后点击或按“放置”。
请输入大于 0 的数值。

column2: Finish or cancel the current operation before dropping files.
column3: 请先完成或取消当前操作，再拖入文件。

column2: Finish the sketch before dropping files (only SVG can be dropped into a sketch).
column3: 请先完成草图再拖入文件（草图中只能拖入 SVG）。

column2: Inscribed: the circle touching the sides (across flats).
column3: 内切：圆与各边相切（按对边间距）。

column2:
It stays centred over its base. To make a shape
follow a path, use Sweep.
column3: 它始终保持相对底面居中。若要让截面沿路径走，请用“扫掠”。

column2: Keep the profile square to the path
Makes the whole interface larger or smaller: text, buttons, spacing and panels together. 100% is the size picked for your display (in Touch mode, the finger-sized default). Takes effect on restart.
column3: 整体放大或缩小界面：文字、按钮、间距和面板一起缩放。100% 是为你的屏幕选定的尺寸（触控模式下为适合手指的默认值）。重启后生效。

column2: Neither sketch is a closed shape - the profile has to be a closed loop such as a circle.
column3: 两个草图都不是封闭形状——截面必须是圆这样的封闭环。

column2: No feature is built from a sketch, so there is nothing to update.
column3: 没有由草图生成的特征，因此无可更新。

column2: Off (default): the bodies stay, as plain solids, when you delete the sketch they were extruded or lathed from. On: the bodies that sketch created are deleted with it (bodies it only cut into are kept). Each is its own undo step.
column3: 关（默认）：删除拉伸/旋转所依据的草图时，实体保留为普通实体。开：该草图创建的实体随之删除（仅被其切除过的实体保留）。两者各自独立撤销。

column2: Off (default): the clock and notifications stay visible above the app. On: the app uses the whole screen; swipe down from the top edge to see the status bar.
column3: 关（默认）：时钟和通知仍显示在应用上方。开：应用占用整屏，从顶部边缘下滑可看状态栏。

column2: On: the profile is turned square to the path so the tube keeps the size you drew. Off: it is swept at whatever angle it was drawn.
column3: 开：截面会转为与路径垂直，管径保持你绘制的大小。关：按绘制时的角度扫掠。

column2: Only change this if the grid looks speckled or flickering with anti-aliasing on. Try 1, 2 and 3 and keep whichever fixes it.
column3: 仅在开启抗锯齿后网格出现斑点或闪烁时才调整。依次试 1、2、3，保留能解决问题的那个。

column2: Re-saves the project on a timer while it has unsaved changes, once it has been saved to a file at least once. Waits while a tool, a sketch or an undone step is open. Large projects can pause briefly while saving.
column3: 项目有未保存改动时按计时器重新保存（至少保存过一次到文件后才生效）。有工具、草图或未完成的步骤打开时会等待。较大的项目保存时可能短暂停顿。

column2: Rebuild every feature from its sketch, so bodies match the sketches again.
column3: 按草图重建每个特征，使实体再次与草图一致。

column2: Round (fillet) or bevel (chamfer) a corner where two lines meet: set the size in the panel, then click each corner.
column3: 在两条线相交的角点做圆角（倒圆）或斜角（倒角）：先在面板里设好尺寸，再逐个点击角点。

column2: SKETCH MODE - Finish Sketch applies, Exit Sketch discards
column3: 草图模式——完成草图应用，退出草图放弃

column2: SKETCH MODE - Press Escape to finish
column3: 草图模式——按 Esc 完成

column2: Set the sweep or radius below, then click or press Place. The cursor chooses which way it bows.
column3: 在下方设置扫掠角或半径，然后点击或按“放置”。弯曲方向由光标位置决定。

column2: Still working out this sketch's regions - they become selectable as soon as that finishes.
column3: 正在解析该草图的区域——完成后即可选中。

column2: Sweep needs exactly two sketches: a closed profile and the path it follows. Ctrl-click both, then click Sweep.
column3: 扫掠需要恰好两个草图：一个封闭截面和它沿着的路径。按住 Ctrl 依次点选两者，再点“扫掠”。

column2: The first sketch has to be a closed shape and the second an open curve (or another closed shape).
column3: 第一个草图必须是封闭形状，第二个是开放曲线（或另一个封闭形状）。

column2: The model already matches its sketches.
The profile is carried to the nearest end of the path.
column3: 截面会被带到路径最近的一端。

column2: Type the chord, then click the end or press Place - or just click it.
column3: 输入弦长后点击终点或按“放置”，也可直接点击。

column2: Type the length and angle below, then click or press Place. A value you leave alone follows the cursor.
column3: 在下方输入长度和角度，然后点击或按“放置”。留空的值会跟随光标。

column2: Type the size below, then click or press Place. It follows the cursor until you do.
column3: 在下方输入尺寸，然后点击或按“放置”。在此之前它跟随光标。

column2: Type the width, height and angle below, then click or press Place. Angle 0 keeps the sides horizontal and vertical.
column3: 在下方输入宽、高和角度，然后点击或按“放置”。角度为 0 时边保持水平/竖直。

column2: Use the other sketch as the profile.
column3: 改用另一个草图作为截面。

column2: Desktop-style. A menu bar on top and every panel visible at once. Best with a mouse and keyboard.
column3: 桌面风格。顶部菜单栏，所有面板同时显示。最适合鼠标和键盘。

column2: Clean and focused. A tool rail on the left, tabbed panels on the right, everything else out of the way. Great on any screen.
column3: 简洁专注。左侧工具栏，右侧分页面板，其余元素收起。适合各种屏幕。

column2: Built for fingers. A full-screen model with floating buttons and big touch targets. Made for tablets.
column3: 为手指而设计。全屏模型、浮动按钮和大触控区域。适合平板。
